{{Money|20}} on death (Hard) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{Attr|Bloated}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Attendee''' was an enemy that appeared in [[The Narratorium]] as a part of [[The Final Act Event]]. It had a low amount of health and above average speed. ==Logbook Description== "''The Attendee is a controlled resident from the overtaken base, Under the Narrator's spell, they are forced to join and help the theater grow. The mask hides their struggling expression as the spell physically controls their body rather than brainwashing their mind.''" ==Appearance== The '''Attendee''' is a dark creature which wears a grey shirt, green vest and a yellow tie. On its head, it wears a white mask. It has three walking animations it can use. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[The Narratorium]] is listed instead. *The '''Attendee''' is quite weak, meaning most early-game towers can handle it. **Early-game towers like the [[Crook Boss]], [[Golden Soldier]] or [[Golden Crook Boss]] are pretty useful here. **The [[Toxic Gunner]] and [[Electroshocker]] can be used to kill multiple at once. *Later on, the '''Attendee''' becomes rather weak, meaning most towers should be capable of defeating them, including late-game towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]], [[Ranger]] or [[Pursuit]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} AttendeeWalk1.gif|Walking animation, first variant (20 December 2025 – Present) AttendeeWalk2.gif|Walking animation, second variant (20 December 2025 – Present) AttendeeWalk3.gif|Walking animation, third variant (20 December 2025 – Present) AttendeeStun.gif|Stun animation (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseAtendee1.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, first animation variant (20 December 2025 – Present) CorpseAtendee2.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, second animation variant (20 December 2025 – Present) CorpseAtendee3.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, third animation variant (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} AttendeeIconIG.png|'''Attendee''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Attendee''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''20 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0]]a **'''Attendee''' added. *'''11 March 2026''' - [[v1.86.0]] **'''Attendee''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{TheNarratorium|Start|N/A|Attendee|Wave 1|[[Fanatic]]|Wave 2}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
